# Nonlinear approach to sector allocation

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #8,475. ## Description

Proposed nonlinear approach to sector allocation: Compare sector-level return, trend, or risk signals and periodically adjust weights among sector funds; concentration and turnover need to be controlled. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
